accounting.rationale: Processor latitude: only the context-required portion of a character intrinsic operation need be evaluated. No future test may require skipped evaluation, a particular evaluation order, or a function-call count.
Informative example of assignment context not requiring evaluation of a trailing function reference; no additional requirement or coverage claim is created.
Defines the context-dependent upper bound on required evaluation; it is a permission/obligation limit, not an executable result requirement.
Allows omission of unneeded portions of the character operation; no plan may assert that a processor did or did not evaluate the omitted part.
